ज्येय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be oppressed, to be deprived
of (property &c.); the most excellent, first, best.

ज्येष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, the most excellent, noblest,
pre-eminent; first, chief; best, greatest; eldest, very
old, elder, senior, elder born; an elder brother; (अस्),
m., N. of a month, for ज्यैष्ठ, q. v.; N. of a
man; (आ), f., N. of the sixteenth or (according to
more modern reckoning) eighteenth lunar mansion
sacred to Indra; the eighth year of a Jupiter
cycle of twelve years; the middle finger; a small
house-lizard; an epithet of the Gaṅgā; a kind of
heroine; misfortune personified as a goddess and the
elder sister of Lakṣmī; (ई), f. a small house-lizard;
(अम्), n. the most excellent, the first, the head; tin;
(अम्), ind. most, extremely; [cf. Hib. gast, ‘an old
woman;’ giostaire, ‘an active old man;’ giostai-
reas, ‘old age.’]
—ज्येष्ठ-घ्नी, f., Ved. = ज्ये-
ष्ठा, the sixteenth lunar mansion.
—ज्येष्ठ-
तम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. best of all; first of all; oldest
of all.
—ज्येष्ठ-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, elder, an elder
one.
—ज्येष्ठ-तस्, ind., Ved. according to seniority,
(reckoning) from the eldest.
—ज्येष्ठ-ता, f. or
ज्येष्ठ-त्व, अम्, n. superiority; primogeniture,
seniority.
—ज्येष्ठ-तात, अस्, m. a father's elder
brother.
—ज्येष्ठ-ताति, इस्, f., Ved. superiority;
superior.
—ज्येष्ठ-पाल, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—ज्येष्ठ-पुष्कर, अम्, n., N. of a renowned
place of pilgrimage.
—ज्येष्ठ-बला, f., N. of a
plant, a kind of Balā, = महा-बला, सह-देवी.
—ज्येष्ठ-भार्या, f. an elder brother's wife, the
elder, senior or chief wife.
—ज्येष्ठ-राज्, ट्, m., Ved.
a sovereign.
—ज्येष्ठ-ललिता, f. a particular vow to
be observed in the month Jyeṣṭha (Jyaiṣṭha).
—ज्येष्ठ-वर्ण, अस्, m. one of the first caste, a
Brāhman.
—ज्येष्ठ-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, behaving like
the first-born or eldest brother; (इस्), f. the duties of
seniority.
—ज्येष्ठ-श्वश्रू, ऊस्, f. a wife's elder
sister.
—ज्येष्ठ-सामन्, अ, n., N. of a Sāman;
(आ, आ, अ), a chanter of the Jyeṣṭha-Sāman.
—ज्ये-
ष्ठसामिक, अस्, आ, अम्, an adj. derived from the
last.
—ज्येष्ठ-स्तोम, अस्, m., N. of an Ekāha
ceremony.
—ज्येष्ठ-स्थान, अम्, n., N. of a place
of pilgrimage.
—ज्येष्ठांश (˚ठ-अं˚), अस्, m.
the eldest brother's share; the right of primogeniture
or the right of the eldest son to a larger portion of
the patrimonial property than his brothers, — a right
formerly recognized but now obsolete; the best share.
—ज्येष्ठा-मूल or ज्येष्ठा-मूलीय, अस्, m. the
month Jyaiṣṭha.
—ज्येष्ठाम्बु (˚ठ-अम्˚), उस्,
m. the scum of boiled rice or water in which grain
has been washed.
—ज्येष्ठाश्रम (˚ठ-आश्˚), अस्,
m. the most excellent order or period in the religious
life of a Brāhman, viz. that of a householder; (अस्,
आ, अम्), being in that period.
—ज्येष्ठाश्रमिन्, ई,
m. a Brāhman in the order of a householder.
—ज्ये-
ष्ठेश्वर (˚ठ-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a Liṅga in
Vārāṇasī.
ज्येष्ठिला, f., N. of a river.
